events.text: Diagnosed: the hmsc-int JS studio has NO unsafe-edit guard at all (it's a native-era invention, guard dialog lives in cart/editor/stage/ModelView.tsx + framework/gpu/3d.zig collectUnsafeFaceEdits). The JS studio is immune BY REPRESENTATION: faces are polygon loops, normals via Newell's method (editMesh.ts faceNormal), and quadTriPositions re-picks the triangulation diagonal every lowering (req_2057) so a folded/non-planar quad silently re-triangulates — this class of error cannot exist there. The native editor edits frozen triangle soup and the guard measures per-triangle before/after cross products against 4 epsilon cliffs (1e-12 floor, 1e-6 relative collapse, -0.05 normal dot, 2e-3 rigid tolerance) — each prior fix (req_2754, req_2755) patched one cliff. Pulling a face folds neighbor quads across their FROZEN diagonal: the tris genuinely degenerate relative to a stale diagonal the JS version would simply have re-picked. Proposed fix: evaluate the guard per AUTHORED GROUP with Newell normals (captureFaceGroups already available at guard time) and/or auto re-pick the diagonal on fold like the JS did (Split Quads, but silent + automatic).

resolution: Analysis ask: compared the hmsc-int JS studio unsafe-edit logic to the native Zig guard as requested. Finding: they cannot align because the JS studio HAS no unsafe-edit guard — the guard is a native-era invention (req_2199 lineage). Deeper: the JS studio is immune by representation — polygon-loop faces, Newell's-method normals, and per-lowering diagonal re-pick (quadTriPositions, req_2057) mean a folded quad silently re-triangulates instead of erroring. The native guard measures frozen triangle soup per-triangle against four epsilon cliffs; every false positive so far (req_2754 rotate, req_2755 pre-degenerate, today's pull-face fold) is the same disease. Recommended per-authored-group Newell check + automatic diagonal re-pick; awaiting user direction before implementing.
